title: Anthropic reaches up to $1.5tn valuation ahead of debut
excerpt: AI company Anthropic is valued at up to $1.5tn as it prepares for its stock market debut after five years in business.
body_html:
Artificial intelligence company Anthropic has reached a valuation of up to $1.5tn ahead of its upcoming stock market debut.

Founded just five years ago, the firm has quickly grown to become one of the most prominent names in the artificial intelligence sector.

Further details regarding the public offering and market entry timeline were not provided in the announcement.
